headline: DSK Legal, Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas act on TiL investing $1.3 billion in Adani Vizhinjam Port

detail: Terminal Investment Limited is investing $1.397 billion for the acquisition of 49% stake in Adani Vizhinjam Port Private Limited, the concessionaire for Vizhinjam Port, from Adani Ports and SEZ Limited. The total consideration will be paid in two tranches: $539 million for the 49% stake in Adani Vizhimjam Port and $858 million upon completion of the Vizhinjam port's expansion by December 2028. DSK Legal assisted TiL in inter alia advising on the overall transaction structure; conducting legal due diligence on Adani Vizhimjam Port; drafting/reviewing, negotiating and finalizing the Transaction documents including share purchase and subscription agreement, shareholders’ agreement and other…
